verdicts.explanation: The abstract and Section 3.4.1 report 3.5 x 10-4 S/cm at room temperature for the 0.05 Sr sample, matching Table 1 (0.29 eV). The 1050 C sintering and 93% relative density are stated for the 0.05 Sr sample, and 8 h sintering applies to the pellet series in Section 2.1. Measurement temperature null is correct because the paper gives only 'room temperature'.
